items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: George Rhodes, who is Sammy Davis Jr.'s conductor today, was on piano; Walter Buchanan on bass, and Poor Jumping George Jones on drums. That was my group.

ctx.x: That was in my group? The trumpet player

was Dave Page, the trombone player was Michael Wood^A and Charlie Fowlkes Folsom was the baritone saxophone player, who is with Basie now. And myself, as the front line, the four horns. George Rhodes, who is Sammy Davis Jr.'s conductor today, was on piano; Walter Buchanan on bass, and Poor Jumping George Jones on drums. That was my group.

Now this is what I had done. When I had my operation, I told them, going in for this operation, "When I come back, if I come back out, the first preference is for you, wherever you may be, and I will send you a notice when I get ready to start back again, if I start back again. I don't know." And I sent every one of them a notice, and do you know, every one of them came back with me when I got up out of bed? Booty was with Erskine Hawkins; he listened to me.
